- Repository:
- Base branch + SHA:

- Changed source/code/document/test/config files:

## Implementation and decisions
- What changed (code and docs):
- Newly created or updated requirement/decision/acceptance files:

## Evidence
- Build/test commands, environment and exit status:
- QA by requirement/AC ID (Pass / Fail / Blocked / Not Run):
- Regression + reduced-motion/keyboard/touch/viewport/locale where relevant:
- Screenshots/recordings/traces with approved privacy handling:
- Preview URL, actual deployed application SHA and Site/hosting revision:
- Incomplete/blocked items and next owner:

## Pre-merge checklist
- [ ] Every AI code AND document change committed and **pushed to GitHub**
- [ ] Remote SHA verified on the intended work branch
- [ ] PR/diff contains all deliberate files, no local-only artifacts
- [ ] No credentials, real candidate details or private customer documents in public diff
- [ ] All test gaps and scope conflicts disclosed
- [ ] Reviewer/Project Owner approval recorded before merge/release
- [ ] No direct publishing over the existing site without authorization

**A Draft PR is not accepted/merged work. If push is blocked: BLOCKED_GITHUB_PUSH.**
